title: Respond to goal-status notices and clarification by revising accountable work
goal: Make participant claims and user clarification change the next work boundary, plan and commitments without letting a status message decide acceptance.
scope: Consume Satisfied/Unachievable/Irrelevant GoalStatusClaim notices at the next work boundary. Insufficient support for Satisfied creates Verify; Unachievable enters FailureDiagnoser then Clarify/Replan/StopPreserving; Irrelevant prompts Planner.revise and cancellation of affected commitments after the trusted revision.

Complete VoiClarification: compare P(misinterpretation) × rework cost with cost_interrupt, ask high-value questions and persist answered Clarification, otherwise record the chosen Assumption/reason and carry it to Report. Support NoQuestions as the control.

Build pending-question/answer/resume operations on the Application/TUI from W1-0014/0015 without freezing independent work. Link replies to the exact question/goal/criterion and reject stale/unrelated answers; commit interpretation changes through W1-0002 intake authority.

Complete Planner.revise and UpfrontDecomposition alternative with versioned PlanRevised, parent WorkItems, all WorkState transitions, dependency/criterion coverage checks and commitment cancellation for replaced work. AsNeededDecomposition splits after diagnosed failure; UpfrontDecomposition proposes a graph before production.
acceptance: An executable cooperation scenario posts all three claim variants and observes the exact Verify, diagnose/escalate or revise/cancel response at the next boundary; an unsupported Satisfied notice never directly changes Acceptance.

High-value ambiguity asks the user, records the answer and resumes affected work; low-value ambiguity records an assumption visible in the final report. An unanswered clarification leaves only dependent work waiting.

AsNeededDecomposition and UpfrontDecomposition produce materially different real plans through the same validator. Cycles, stale revisions, lost required criteria and invalid cancellation are denied while accepted work and provenance survive revision.
context: Authority: ymp-docs/self-organizing-team-domain-model.md, sections 3.2/3.3/3.5, P3/P6, 5.1 (IntakePolicy), 5.2 (Planner), A3/A9 and R-3/R-6. Use the approved model with 811a872 semantics and the greenfield baseline in 0c61ff1 and §5.8 for experimental strategy boundaries. Other documents and existing names explain implementation facts only.

Greenfield: create this behavior in the new implementation. Paths below are PROPOSED target modules under the layout owned by W1-0001; only completed prerequisite tasks supply implementation. Prior source, APIs, fixtures and delivery claims are not a baseline.

Create plan-revision/P3/P6 orchestration using the W1 Planner/intake/commitment contracts and W3 Board/allocation. Proposed modules are runtime/policies/intake.rs and planner.rs plus kernel/plans.rs; add only necessary question/answer UI interaction.

An Irrelevant notice does not erase a required user criterion. P3 revises/cancels work through trusted transitions; a contract change needs its user/clarification basis. A Satisfied notice requests verification when evidence is insufficient.

AsNeededDecomposition and UpfrontDecomposition are actual interchangeable planning mechanisms. Record forecast/VOI/cost_interrupt basis, charged Planner calls and answered versus assumed interpretation. A replanned graph preserves immutable accepted results.
